description: The PATIENTS table contains demographic and mortality information for patients. Key fields include a unique patient identifier (SUBJECT_ID), gender, date of birth (DOB), and dates of death from various sources (DOD, DOD_HOSP, DOD_SSN). The EXPIRE_FLAG indicates whether the patient record has expired. ROW_ID is a unique identifier for each row.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the PATIENTS table, representing a unique patient identifier.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: Patient's gender, recorded as either 'M' (male) or 'F' (female).

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: Patient's date of birth.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: Patient's date of death, if applicable.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: Date of death as recorded in the hospital. This may differ from the date of death recorded elsewhere.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: Date of death as recorded by the Social Security Administration. This may differ from the date of death recorded elsewhere.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the patient's record has expired. 1 indicates the record is expired, 0 indicates it is not.

description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information on individual hospital admissions for patients in the dataset. It includes demographics, admission and discharge times, admission types and locations, insurance details, diagnoses, and in-hospital mortality status. This table provides a comprehensive overview of each patient's hospital stay.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the dataset.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: The date and time of hospital admission.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: The date and time of hospital discharge.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: The date and time of death for patients who died in the hospital. Null if the patient did not die during the hospitalization.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: The type of admission (e.g., EMERGENCY, ELECTIVE, NEWBORN, URGENT).

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the patient prior to admission (e.g., PHYS REFERRAL/NORMAL DELI, CLINIC REFERRAL/PREMATURE).

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: The location to which the patient was discharged (e.g., HOME, LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL).

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: The type of insurance the patient has (e.g., Medicaid, Self Pay).

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: The primary language spoken by the patient.

columns.name: RELIGION
columns.description: The patient's self-identified religion.

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.description: The patient's marital status.

columns.name: ETHNICITY
columns.description: The patient's ethnicity.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was registered in the emergency department. Null if the patient was not seen in the ED.

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient left the emergency department. Null if the patient was not seen in the ED.

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: The primary diagnosis for the patient's admission.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag indicating whether the patient died in the hospital (1) or not (0) during this admission.

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: A flag indicating whether there is associated chart events data for this admission (1) or not (0).

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in ADMISSIONS table is a foreign key referencing SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS table.
